desc: Precompute H=N/2, D=N(N-1)//2, R=D-H+1, factorials/invfacts, inverses, binomials, and transition terms for all a,b in 1..H.
Build valid DP transitions grouped by source total vertices, enforcing parity layer alternation and remaining even/odd vertex limits.
Implement evaluation at x=1..R using precomputed transition weights, scalar DP over states in increasing total order, and multiplication by (N-1)!.
Evaluate the polynomial at x=0..R with f(0)=0 and interpolate the degree<=R polynomial via Newton forward differences into monomial coefficients.
Wire up stdin/stdout, output coeff[M] for M=N-1..D with zeros for M>R, and verify sample cases and edge cases.
